description: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions. I am building Sidra, an AI health monitoring companion that protects astronauts from space radiation and microgravity.  I am passionate about space health and human exploration
summary: Sidra is an AI-powered biomedical companion designed to support astronaut health during space missions. It monitors vital signs, analyzes health data, and predicts potential medical risks before they become serious. It addresses the challenge of limited medical support in space by giving astronauts instant, intelligent health monitoring and prediction. It is important because it helps keep astronauts safe, enables longer missions, and brings space healthcare closer to real-time, preventive care
details:
Sidra - Space Bio-Medical Companion is a web-based AI assistant for astronaut health monitoring and prediction.

What it does: It tracks astronaut health indicators, provides health insights, alerts for abnormal conditions, and offers guidance for daily health routines in space.

How it works: The user enters health data and symptoms, and the AI analyzes it using NASA GeneLab data to detect risks, predict health problems, and provide personalized recommendations. It has an easy dashboard for monitoring and quick access to health information.

Benefits: Early detection of health problems, prediction of risks before they become serious, reduced dependence on Earth-based medical teams, better decision-making in emergencies, and improved astronaut well-being.

Goals: To make space missions safer, support long-duration missions, and use AI to solve real biomedical challenges in space.

Tools used: Google AI Studio for app design, Meta AI for guidance, Gamma for PPTX presentation, NASA GeneLab data, GitHub for project sharing.

Future Work: In the future, we aim for Sidra to also participate in treatment by developing a natural product medicine for the health problems that Sidra detects
